model: deterministic loopback Responses responder, not live model weights
transport: container Codex CLI to stdio relay to owner-side connector to private MCP socket
agentNetwork: none, except container loopback to its deterministic responder
agentRoot: read-only with writable /tmp and hook state
agentAuthentication: none; dummy key only for loopback responder
limits: The model output was predetermined by a local responder. This verifies CLI, hook, bridge, gateway, and runner wiring under a distinct UID; it does not measure poisoned-weight trigger reliability or live model utility. The native hook and Codex process still share the agent UID; read-only policy and bundle mounts limit this particular setup, but the trial does not prove resistance to arbitrary compromise of that process.
